verdict.rationale: The full-application end of the story is well documented. SvelteKit is positioned as Svelte's Next/Nuxt equivalent, with routing, SSR, SPA and SSG modes. Svelte can also be built without SvelteKit, with `npm run build` emitting HTML/JS/CSS to `dist`. However, nothing in the pack shows mounting Svelte into a small part of an existing page or growing incrementally from there. The community migration report describes a wholesale React-to-Svelte rewrite, not incremental adoption. missing for 10: documentation of embedding or mounting a component into part of an existing non-Svelte page, an explicit incremental-adoption path from widget to full app, and independent corroboration of incremental adoption.
